'''Irolunn''' was a valuable gas available in the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]], according to [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Lanius Qel-Bertuk]]. He mentioned it along with [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]], and they were presumably to be found on the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] of [[Genarius]].
